method: Fresh serial standalone-file contexts per checkout with the field index open and closed through its real control. Each phase records a 1 ms Chrome CPU sampling profile, marker-bounded native trace and aggregate Performance counters. Profiled wall time includes instrumentation and is not the acceptance latency benchmark. Native/layout work may appear as unsymbolized program time; CPU function samples do not attribute native layout to a JavaScript function.
notEstablished: These diagnostics do not clear or suppress material latency flags in expansion-native-status.json
Continuous frame rate, cross-engine performance, manual G01 and live interoperability
traceMethod: Native trace X-event durations are clipped to explicit console TimeStamp markers around the action on the same renderer thread. Event durations are inclusive and overlap parents/children; do not sum rows. Performance counters exclude profiler/tracing startup and shutdown, but the action still runs under diagnostic instrumentation.
visibilityControl: Repeat both checkouts after closing the field index through its real UI button. This is a presentation diagnostic on unmodified application bytes, not a replacement for default-open acceptance or its retained material flags.
